assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are maintainer-defined provisional geometry derived from public announcement text and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions are conceptual and must be regenerated when official or cleared polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Official qualification-package, addendum, or cleared CAD/GIS/PDF boundary is supplied.
assumptions.required_action: Replace site_boundary and key_areas, then regenerate every design layer, metric, figure, HTML page, and drawing.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, control lines, land ownership, and parcel conditions are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: The package provides design reference logic rather than statutory control values.
assumptions.trigger: Approved regulatory-plan conditions and official design attachments become available.
assumptions.required_action: Reclassify pending metrics and test every building, road, and public-space move against the official controls.

assumptions.statement: The heritage park, Qinghe/Xiaoyuehe interfaces, Qinghuayuan station site and related protection/control zones require an official cultural-resource layer.
assumptions.impact: The proposal uses low-impact heritage interpretation and keeps construction claims open.
assumptions.trigger: Official heritage inventory and protection/control-zone data are cleared for design use.
assumptions.required_action: Run a heritage review before any material, interface, lighting, signage, or event detail is deepened.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, station entrances, transit demand, parking supply, bike facilities and crossing constraints are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The loop is a conceptual slow-mobility and service relationship, not an engineering alignment.
assumptions.trigger: Official transport base data and safety review are supplied.
assumptions.required_action: Re-test network continuity, accessible crossings, emergency access, station interfaces and parking operations.

assumptions.statement: Utility, drainage, flood, energy, fire, data-centre and edge-compute capacity information is not available.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute and public-service nodes remain reference prototypes with no load or engineering claim.
assumptions.trigger: Municipal and infrastructure surveys are made available for professional coordination.
assumptions.required_action: Complete energy, water, drainage, fire, cyber and maintenance coordination before implementation decisions.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, open scenarios and developer-community operations are proposed operating patterns, not confirmed schedules or funding arrangements.
assumptions.impact: The proposal can be tested through low-cost public programmes before any permanent space commitment.
assumptions.trigger: A responsible operating partnership and public-space permit path are identified.
assumptions.required_action: Publish a service charter, escalation route, accessibility plan, data-retention rule and annual review report.

assumptions.statement: Only repository materials and the listed public primary sources support this package; personal, proprietary, restricted and uncleared spatial data are excluded.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards use aggregation, consent and human review rather than personal tracking.
assumptions.trigger: A proposed scenario requests a new dataset or a new public-facing generative service.
assumptions.required_action: Record purpose, provenance, license, minimization, retention, complaint handling and human fallback before the test begins.
